    Prototype with hard-coded demo data standing in for the YouTube and Twitch APIs, shown as if both were connected and working. YouTube channel totals are public figures from Oct 31 to Nov 1, 2026. The three “Vault pick” videos are yours, but their view counts, watch time and retention are made up. The Watch and Videos tabs use real Twitch and YouTube players. The live match, fan posts, points and prizes are made up. Like, comment, reaction and play counts on streams and shorts are made up (anything you add stays on this device). Short clips are cut at guessed start times. Team, player and moment details come from public coverage up to Nov 14, 2026 and should be checked before launch. Brand artwork (tiger camo and patterns) belongs to FaZe Clan and is used unaltered; get FaZe’s written approval before launch. Predictions use earned points only. The Arcade uses separate play-money chips that can’t be exchanged for points or prizes. No money in or out.
